channel.title: Babel — Project News & Release Notes
channel.description: Official releases, browser store milestones, newly integrated generative studios, security bulletins, and technical evolutions of the Babel project.

item.title: Main Release Open for Testing on Chrome Web Store — Edge & Opera Reviews Underway, Local Version in Development
item.description: The main production release of Babel is now open for public testing directly on the Chrome Web Store, while multi-browser store certifications proceed for Microsoft Edge Add-ons and Opera Addons, and engineering on a local standalone desktop application (supporting custom API keys via BYOK and offline local models via Ollama and LM Studio) actively begins.

item.title: Babel v1.10.8: Chameleon Radial HUD, In-Place Proofreading & Selection Translation
item.description: Babel delivers instant in-place text translation, grammar proofreading, and AI prompt refinement directly inside any web input field with simple keyboard shortcuts. Featuring the Chameleon Radial HUD, 23 target languages, in-place proofreading (Alt + P), in-place selection translation (Alt + U), and smart mention preservation.

item.title: AI Prompt Engineering Engine: Cinematic Image & Video Presets
item.description: Elevate raw ideas into structured, high-detail cinematic prompts tailored specifically for creative generative studios directly inside generator prompt boxes: Midjourney, Higgsfield AI, Google FLOW (Veo / Gemini Omni), Flux LoRAs, and Civitai diffusion models.

item.title: Offline Keyboard Layout Fixer (1ms) & 8 Adaptive Speech Tones
item.description: Two high-frequency productivity superpowers: offline keyboard layout fixer (Ctrl + Shift + F in 1ms without quota) and 8 adaptive speech tones: Natural, Friendly, Internet Slang, Professional Business, Brief, Vivid, Prompt Mode, and offline Base64.

item.title: Strict Zero-Log Privacy, Built-In DLP & Domain Whitelist
item.description: Client-side Data Loss Prevention automatically masks API tokens, passwords, and sensitive keys before transmission. Zero data retention over TLS 1.3, domain whitelisting, and transparent capacity tiers.
